description: baseline: unchanged code, harness and guards in place

asi.estimator: min-of-3 per card, summed. process_time is quantised to Windows' 15.6ms tick and counts numpy threads; canary-normalisation held 6% on one batch and blew to 61% on the next.
asi.priority: ABOVE_NORMAL scheduling was the real fix - same code went 10.5-11.7s to 6.8-7.6s on a busy desktop. canary_mean ~36 means quiet, >55 means contended.
asi.noise: ~12% floor on card_ms_total. rows_to_python/service_calls/bytes_total are exact and arbitrate.
asi.shape: 7d and patterns each hydrate 20,159 rows; today 2,518; last_12h 1,439. Patterns then groups to hour-of-day and discards the resolution - 168 hourly buckets carry the same heatmap.
asi.guard: fidelity.py negative-tested: plotting 5-minute means fails with 'last_7d/pm25: peak lost - plotted 51.9, true 57.3'.
